_comment: LANE C / F - THE PARITY MATRIX door table. Rows = doors that admit a class, columns = the checks a door of that class must run. The EMPTY CELLS ARE THE FINDING. Adding a class here is how the matrix grows; a door absent from this table is a door the matrix says nothing about, which is why `classes[].doors` must list EVERY admitting door for the class and `unlisted_doors_note` must say how that was established.
_honesty_rules: A cell is FILLED only by a CALL in production source, found over comment-masked lines. A check named in a doc comment can never fill a cell.

An unproven reachability claim ('a framed blob cannot have passed the caller's precheck, so this arm should be unreachable') is an EMPTY CELL, NOT A FILLED ONE. The generator scans for claim language and annotates the empty cell with it; it never converts it.

The only thing that legitimately empties a cell is an EXEMPTION with a stated reason of NON-COMPUTABILITY at that door (e.g. a jumping adopter cannot compute the DAA equality: it holds no ancestry). An exemption whose reason is itself a reachability claim is REFUSED by the generator and the cell stays EMPTY.

Call-graph edges are followed only through receivers the reader can resolve honestly (`self.`, `Self::`, `crate::..::`, bare free fn). Every other receiver is left UNRESOLVED, which biases the matrix toward EMPTY - the direction that produces a candidate hole to disprove, never the direction that hides one.
cfg(test) modules and test-attributed functions are neither doors nor resolution targets: a door filled by its own test is not a door that runs the check.

It fills this cell; the residual - a STRIPPED part - is named on the shared function and reported open there, not here.

block._comment: A block/shell entering the DAG. E-8 (descent door x pow_verified) and A2 (descent door x timestamp) both live here.

doors.role: REFERENCE - the gossip door proper; the row every other row of this class is compared against
the node-side gossip ingest lane (calls preverify_block, then hands to the relay)
the shared gossip preverify body (header + proof only, holds no DAG)
the 7u8 block-lane / block-locator DESCENT door (E-8, A2)
the descent door's shared body (present only after the 2026-09-07 fix)
the fold carry's ancestor + carried-block install door (Dag::add_ancestor_anchor below it is the PLACEMENT, not the decision)

block.unlisted_doors_note: Established by `grep -n 'fn .*block' src/node.rs src/dag.rs src/node_runtime.rs` for functions that place a Block into the DAG. Any door NOT in this list is outside the matrix and the matrix makes NO claim about it.

tx._comment: A transaction entering the pool. B3 (ingest_tx_prechecked x class_admissible) lives here.
tx.unlisted_doors_note: The three `fn ingest_tx*` arms in src/node.rs; no other production caller inserts into the pool through node.rs.

record_page._comment: A record/sidecar row reaching the shared fold sink. C-H2 lives here.
record_page._checks_note: The three ROOT-BINDING RELATIONS the 2026-09-07 audit names on the reference door, read out of `accept_fetched_record` itself rather than assumed: the certified-target close, the per-ordinal fold-to-root walk, and the ordinal placement. C-H2's finding is that the sidecar door runs NONE of them.
record_page.unlisted_doors_note: Both named by the 2026-09-07 door audit as the two doors reaching the fold sink for this class.

bulk_stream._comment: The 16 MiB bulk body read. D-6 lives here: inbound x read_guard is empty, outbound x read_guard is filled.

doors.role: reference - the OUTBOUND twin, wraps both reads in timeout(60s)

bulk_stream.unlisted_doors_note: The two halves of the same 4-byte-length + body wire exchange in src/arti_transport.rs.

exemptions._schema: Every exemption needs door, check, class and noncomputable_because. The generator REFUSES a reason written as a reachability claim and leaves the cell EMPTY.
exemptions.noncomputable_because: preverify_block is a pure header+proof function taking no &self: it holds no DAG, so parent presence is not a quantity in scope at this door. Its caller ingest_block_inner is the door that owns placement, and the matrix scores that row separately.
